dedupe_keys.name: centreau quebec city wastewater covid surveillance tables

description: This versioned release provides wastewater and related public-health measurements for Québec City in the Open Data Model format. The repository README describes tables for laboratory wastewater measurements, site measurements such as flow, and COVID-19 public-health observations, with a wide view for aligned timestamps. It explains that qualityFlag distinguishes uncertain, accepted and unchecked records and that notes may describe problems. Zenodo identifies the version 1.04 archive and CC BY 4.0 licence; this review did not download the eight-megabyte ZIP or inspect table rows. A modeller could use the site and time series to compare wastewater signals with reported disease burden or test how sewer sampling coverage affects public-health monitoring scenarios. The README discusses a wider Québec program with 31 sites, but this release is explicitly Part 1, Québec City; its exact site count and temporal bounds need checks in the archive. Data came from multiple laboratories, municipalities and public-health reports with differing validation effort. Related resources include the original site records and Open Data Model specification. Existing accepted discovery candidates do not amount to a catalogue record.
